Supply Chain Planner 

Lijnden, North Holland, Netherlands
About the job
SUPPLY CHAIN PLANNER

Keep the flow moving, so the business keeps delivering.



Lijnden | Logistics / Supply Chain | Full-time

At Just Brands, we build menswear brands with character. PME Legend, Cast Iron and Vanguard each have their own voice, their own audience, and their own place in the market. Behind every strong collection and every successful delivery is a supply chain that runs with precision. When goods move at the right time, in the right way, and with the right control, the entire business performs better.



But what really sets us apart is how we work together.



We’re a team-first business. No ego, no unnecessary layers, no endless talking, no corporate theatre. We back each other, speak up, take ownership and keep pushing for better. We work hard, stay sharp and make sure there’s room to enjoy the ride too.



That’s where your engine starts.



Why this role matters

This is where coordination meets operational impact. As our Supply Chain Planner, you help keep the end-to-end goods flow running smoothly, efficiently and on time. You make sure inbound and outbound processes stay aligned, bottlenecks are spotted early, and the right actions are taken to keep performance on track. You are not here to just follow the flow.



You are here to keep our supply chain moving smarter every day.



What you’ll do

Coordinate daily inbound and outbound goods flows;
Maintain close contact with suppliers and logistics partners to ensure on-time deliveries;
Monitor SLAs and KPIs of service providers and identify deviations;
Manage daily sub-processes within the supply chain and actively contribute to improvement initiatives;
Identify bottlenecks and propose improvements to enhance process efficiency;
Support forecast analyses and coordinate inventory management with internal stakeholders;
Prepare short- and mid-term planning schedules for logistics partners;
Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve operational performance.


What makes this role exciting

You play a direct role in keeping the business running smoothly;
You work at the intersection of logistics, suppliers and internal teams;
You combine operational control with continuous improvement;
You join a close-knit team that works fast and improves daily;
You help turn better planning into better delivery performance and customer satisfaction.


You’ll probably love this role if you…

like bringing structure to moving parts;
enjoy solving operational puzzles before they become problems;
stay calm and accurate under pressure;
get energy from improving processes, not just following them;
prefer practical impact over unnecessary complexity;


What you bring

Experience in supply chain, logistics planning or a similar operational role;
Strong analytical skills and a structured way of working;
The ability to keep overview, even during peak periods;
Clear and effective communication with different stakeholders;
Strong logical thinking and solid Excel skills;


What Just Brands is really like

We are ambitious, but grounded. We care about quality, and we are confident in what we build. No ego. We move fast, but we do it together. That’s the Just Brands rhythm.



You’ll Join a Company Where

People help each other out;
Ideas and people matter more than job titles;
Hard work matters, and so does enjoying the ride;
If something can be better, we improve it;


What you get

You step into a role with direct operational impact in a vital cross functional department that keeps building and improving. You'll help drive smarter planning, stronger delivery performance and better results across the business.



1 day remote from home;
An end-of-year bonus of one gross monthly salary;
A healthy and varied lunch every day;
Move in our own gym and take sport lessons;
Parties and drinks that will be talked about for years to come;
Extraordinary staff discount on our clothing.
